---
title: "Lean 4 Formalization"
subtitle: "Sorry-free formalization in Lean v4.35.0 + Mathlib"
jupyter: python3
---

The Lean 4 formalization lives in [`lean/MixedSignCoxeter/`](https://github.com/jkylearmstrong/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/tree/main/lean/MixedSignCoxeter) and builds cleanly (`3663` jobs, zero `sorry`, zero `axiom`) against **Lean `v4.35.0`** and Mathlib.

## Formalization Progress

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import re
from pathlib import Path

lean_dir = next(p for p in (Path("../lean/MixedSignCoxeter"), Path("lean/MixedSignCoxeter")) if p.exists())
lean_files = sorted(lean_dir.glob("*.lean"))
counts = {"theorem": 0, "lemma": 0, "def": 0, "structure": 0, "sorry": 0}
for f in lean_files:
    text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    counts["theorem"] += len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(?:private\s+)?theorem\b", text))
    counts["lemma"] += len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(?:private\s+)?lemma\b", text))
    counts["def"] += len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(?:private\s+)?(?:def|abbrev)\b", text))
    counts["structure"] += len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*structure\b", text))
    counts["sorry"] += len(re.findall(r"\bsorry\b", text))

print("| Metric | Count | Status |")
print("| :--- | :---: | :--- |")
print(f"| Lean 4 Modules | {len(lean_files)} | ✅ `lake build` passes |")
print(f"| Definitions & Structures | {counts['def'] + counts['structure']} | ✅ Complete |")
print(f"| Lemmas | {counts['lemma']} | ✅ Complete |")
print(f"| Theorems | {counts['theorem']} | ✅ Complete |")
print(f"| Remaining `sorry` | {counts['sorry']} | ✅ 100% sorry-free |")
```

## End-to-End Traceability (`data/theorems.yml`)

```{text}
Dissertation Theorem
        ⇓
Lean 4 Formalization
        ⇓
Python Implementation
        ⇓
Interactive Explorer
```


The table below is generated directly from [`data/theorems.yml`](https://github.com/jkylearmstrong/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/blob/main/data/theorems.yml), the same registry used by the Shiny Explorer's Theorem Checker. For the full statement-by-statement mapping of all 107 numbered items in Chapters 1–3 of the dissertation, see the [Complete 107-Statement Index](dissertation.qmd#complete-statement-index) ([download CSV](assets/mixed_sign_coxeter_statements_lean.csv)).

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml
from pathlib import Path

theorems_path = next(p for p in (Path("../data/theorems.yml"), Path("data/theorems.yml")) if p.exists())
theorems = yaml.safe_load(theorems_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["theorems"]
print("| Dissertation | Lean 4 Theorem | Python Implementation | Explorer Preset | Status |")
print("| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |")
for t in theorems:
    lean_col = f"[`{t['lean_symbol']}`]({t['lean_url']})" if t.get("lean_url") else "—"
    if t.get("lean_url") and " / " in t["lean_symbol"]:
        lean_col = " / ".join(f"`{sym}`" for sym in t["lean_symbol"].split(" / "))
        lean_col = f"[{lean_col}]({t['lean_url']})"
    py_col = f"[`{t['python_ref']}`]({t['python_url']})"
    exp_col = f"[`{t['preset']}`](explorer.qmd)"
    print(f"| **{t['dissertation_ref']}**: {t['title']} | {lean_col} | {py_col} | {exp_col} | {t['status']} |")
```

## Building Locally

```bash
cd lean
lake exe cache get
lake build
```

## Module Dependency Architecture

Every module ultimately builds on `Basic.lean` (`ReflectionSystem`, bilinear form `B`, reflections). The graph is split into four views to keep each dependency chain readable.

<!-- BEGIN lean-module-graph (generated by scripts/lean_module_graph.py; do not edit) -->

These diagrams are generated from the `import` lines of all 27 modules (33 direct imports between them). Each module belongs to one view. The overview shows how the four views connect; each view below shows its own modules (solid boxes and arrows) along with dashed stubs for direct upstream imports from other views.
